run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-17T23:22:23Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The warning alert RequestErrorRate on otel-demo/checkout is matched by checkout error spans that first appear in the sampled span metrics at 23:23:00 (0.2 error spans/s, the first minute any span-metric sample exists) and persist through the end of the sampled window (137 error spans in 23:52:20-00:02:20). Within checkout only the PlaceOrder operation errors (span names 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and its paired client span 'HTTP POST'). Every failing trace shows checkout's PlaceOrder failing inside prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart on its HTTP POST to shipping's '/get-quote' endpoint, with gRPC status 13 INTERNAL and the recorded status description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400'; in those traces shipping's '/get-quote' span is sub-millisecond and has no 'POST quote' child, whereas successful traces show '/get-quote' -> 'POST quote' -> quote 'POST /getquote' and a later email 'POST /send_order_confirmation' returning http.status_code 200. Because failing traces contain no email span at all and the sampled email confirmation calls returned 200, the 400 observed by checkout was returned by the shipping endpoint, not by email; the inner clause naming email conflicts with the trace structure and its exact meaning could not be resolved. Pods are all running/ready with zero restarts, all otel-demo ReplicaSets except flagd and load-generator are revision 1 from 23:12:14-23:12:16, and no eviction or container-failure events exist; every flagd fault flag is off in the currently readable flagd-config, so no enabled fault-injection setting matches this failure. Callers (frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator) show their own error spans with 500/error status and the propagated message. The internal reason shipping rejects a subset of quote requests, whether errors predate the first available metric sample, and the state of the flagd flags at 23:22 remain unknown, so the conclusion is partial and the root cause is named at the shipping Deployment with that caveat.

claims.text: Checkout error spans (status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR) rise from 0.2 spans/s in the first minute the span-metric series are available (23:23:00) to a peak of about 2.7 spans/s around 23:31, and stay elevated across the window; the last 10 minutes sampled (23:52:20-00:02:20) still contain 137 error spans of checkout's PlaceOrder span pair.

Within service checkout, error spans are confined to exactly two span names, 'HTTP POST' and 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' (5-minute increases 70, 134.4, 146.7, 107.8, 140, 32.2, 77.8 across the window); checkout's other span names (GetCart, EmptyCart, Convert, Charge, GetProduct, 'orders publish', prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart) show no error series.

A scan of all services' error spans over 20-minute windows returns error series for checkout (HTTP POST, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder), frontend (POST, POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder), frontend-proxy (ingress, 'router frontend egress'), plus low-rate flagd EventStream series on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation; no error series exists for shipping, quote, email, cart, payment, currency or product-catalog.

The checkout PlaceOrder spans carry the exact error status description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400' with error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=13; frontend records the same text as '13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400' and returns HTTP 500.

In failing trace f3a65504359935eddc5f91b4b9431c6d the erroring checkout client span 'HTTP POST' (1248 us, error=true) has exactly one child, the shipping service span '/get-quote' (599 us, started at the same instant), and that shipping span has no 'POST quote' child; the trace contains 15 spans and no email span. The same pattern repeats in the other sampled failing traces (shipping '/get-quote' seen at 40, 248 and 469 us under erroring checkout POSTs) and in trace fabf30c40bb674e79e93dd78836bb231.

Successful checkout traces in the same window show the complete dependency chain: checkout 'HTTP POST' -> shipping '/get-quote' (17.7 ms and 36.4 ms) -> shipping 'POST quote' -> quote 'POST /getquote' (316 and 444 us), and later checkout 'HTTP POST' -> email 'POST /send_order_confirmation' with http.status_code=200 (about 4.4 ms) plus email internal 'send_email' and 'sinatra.render_template' spans.

The checkout pod's own log stream during 23:26:55-23:27:06 shows normal progress lines '[PlaceOrder]', 'payment went through', 'order placed', 'order confirmation email sent to "<user>@example.com"' and 'sending to postProcessor' for the orders in that interval, so orders were still completing while checkout error spans were being produced.

The shipping pod's returned log lines for 23:15-23:35 consist only of 'Requesting quote', 'Sending Quote' and 'Tracking ID Created' (100 newest of 2256 in-window matching lines, from 23:34:13 to 23:34:58); for 23:26:55-23:27:02 the same three message types appear at 23:26:55, 23:26:59, 23:27:00 and 23:27:02, and no log line exists for the failing quote requests (for example the shipping span started at 23:27:02.586 in trace fabf30c40bb674e79e93dd78836bb231).

The quote service's returned log lines for 23:33:46-23:34:58 are only 'Calculated quote' (60 newest of 752 matching lines), and the email service's span operations as listed by Jaeger are 'POST /send_order_confirmation' (server), 'send_email' and 'sinatra.render_template'.

All 21 otel-demo pods are Running and ready with container restartCount 0; pod start times are 23:12:14-23:12:16 (all services, including checkout-5dccddf8bb-vh65b, shipping-75d58f5d84-kgmz9, email-59f69bc6cf-7wqqk, quote-6b5877698d-x6v2f) and 23:14:05 for flagd, while load-generator-7d5756fbd9-zzj4z was created at 23:46:29.

Every otel-demo ReplicaSet other than flagd and load-generator is deployment revision 1 created at 23:12:14-23:12:16 with its normal image (checkout ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, shipping ...:2.1.3-shipping, email ...:2.1.3-email); flagd has revision 2 with kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T23:14:05Z and load-generator revision 2 with kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T23:46:29Z, both on the same images as their revision 1.

The only events recorded for otel-demo inside the authorized window are the load-generator rollout: Deployment load-generator ScalingReplicaSet (scale up 7d5756fbd9, scale down c7cbc4c99), ReplicaSet load-generator-7d5756fbd9 SuccessfulCreate, ReplicaSet load-generator-c7cbc4c99 SuccessfulDelete, and Pod Created/Pulled/Started (zzj4z) / Killing (xlnk2) at 23:46:29-23:46:30; all other events in the cluster belong to namespace data-recorders (PVC, Job and StatefulSet activity).

The ConfigMap flagd-config (namespace otel-demo, key demo.flagd.json) currently has every fault-injection flag at defaultVariant 'off' (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) and loadGeneratorFloodHomepage at defaultVariant '100', with all flags in state ENABLED; the flagd Deployment runs '--uri file:./etc/flagd/demo.flagd.json' with the ConfigMap mounted as config-ro.

Span-metric series for all services are only available from about 23:22-23:23 inside the authorized window: a 1-minute rate query on traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend"} starting at 23:00 returns its first point at 23:23:00 (source_start_at 23:23:00), and the checkout series likewise first return at 23:23:00 (checkout error 0.2 spans/s), with a single shipping data point at 23:22:23.

The HTTP 400 was produced by the shipping service's '/get-quote' endpoint, which rejects a subset of checkout's quote requests before any call to the quote service (no 'POST quote' child span, sub-millisecond server span, no 'Requesting quote' log line), so the alert-driving checkout failures originate at the shipping endpoint rather than at email.

Alternatively the rejected quote requests may originate in checkout's own request construction (checkout builds a quote payload that shipping's input validation rejects with 400), which would place the fault in the checkout Deployment rather than in shipping; the available evidence (a checkout client error span, no shipping error tag, no shipping error log) cannot distinguish these two options.

The load-generator rollout at 23:46:29 (new ReplicaSet 7d5756fbd9 replacing c7cbc4c99, same image) changed request mix or volume but is unlikely to be the origin, because checkout error spans already existed from 23:23:00 and continued at 137 error spans in 23:52:20-00:02:20; it is recorded as a change during the window whose effect is unverified.

Rejected: that the email service returned HTTP 400 and caused these checkout failures. The failing traces contain no email span at all (the request fails in the prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart step before any confirmation call), the sampled email 'POST /send_order_confirmation' spans return http.status_code=200, checkout logged 'order confirmation email sent to ...' during the failure period, and no error series exists for service email.

Rejected as the observed cause: a currently enabled flagd fault-injection flag on checkout, shipping, email or quote. The flagd-config file read in this Run has every failure, memory-leak and latency flag at defaultVariant 'off', no enabled fault flag names shipping or checkout, and no checkout, shipping, email or quote pod or ReplicaSet was replaced during the window (all revision 1 from 23:12).

Counter-evidence against calling shipping 'healthy': shipping's own spans carry no error status and its logs show no error lines, yet its '/get-quote' span is the endpoint where checkout's erroring client POST terminates, so shipping's telemetry is silent on these requests rather than exonerating.

Affected on their own telemetry: frontend records error spans for 'POST', 'POST /api/checkout', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' with http.status_code=500 and the message '13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400'; frontend-proxy records error spans for 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' (http.status_code=500); load-generator records error spans for 'POST' (http.status_code=500) on the same traces.

Checked and not failing in their own telemetry: cart, currency, payment, product-catalog, quote, shipping and email have no error spans or error-rate series in the scanned windows, and in the sampled traces their calls return rpc.grpc.status_code=0, quote returns its 'POST /getquote' spans successfully, and email returns http.status_code=200.

Inspect the shipping Deployment's '/get-quote' request validation and capture the raw 400 response body checkout receives (for example by enabling debug logging for rejected quote requests), to determine whether shipping rejects valid traffic or checkout sends invalid payloads.

Restore visibility of the pre-23:22 period (OpenTelemetry collector/Prometheus trace-metric pipeline history and Jaeger retention) and add change history for flagd-config, because the span-metric series begin only at about 23:22-23:23 and flagd was restarted at 23:14:05 with an unchanged image.

gaps: The internal reason the shipping '/get-quote' endpoint returns HTTP 400 is not observable: shipping's server spans carry no status tag and its logs contain no line for the rejected requests.

Whether the rejected quote requests are caused by a shipping-side validation fault or by malformed requests built in checkout cannot be distinguished with the available telemetry (the checkout client spans carry no URL or request-body tags).

The error text names the email service ('failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400') while the only failing call visible in the traces is checkout -> shipping '/get-quote'; the exact origin of that wording could not be verified.

Span-metric samples start only at about 23:22-23:23 inside the authorized window, so error behaviour before 23:22:23 (the alert start) is unknown rather than zero; the alert's own evaluation expression could not be checked because list_prometheus_rules returned nothing for the rule name RequestErrorRate (status no_data).

The rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count and http_server_request_duration_seconds_count metrics have no series in this Prometheus (get_series returned no_data for rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count and get_all_labels returned no_data for http_server_request_duration_seconds_count), so per-endpoint HTTP status and gRPC client status cannot be read from metrics.

The flagd-config ConfigMap is only observable in its current state; whether any fault flag was switched on at 23:22:23 and later off cannot be verified, and the change_history integration is not available in this Run.

The flagd Deployment was restarted at 23:14:05 and load-generator at 23:46:29 with unchanged images and templates; what triggered the flagd restart and whether it relates to the failure could not be determined.

The email container log read for 23:12:00-00:02:00 returned no lines (status no_data) and a filtered email error search returned nothing, so email's request-level behaviour is known only from its spans; and Jaeger keeps only recent traces, so spans outside the sampled window are unknown.

Shipping's error-tag search (traces_search_by_tags service=shipping tags http.status_code="400") returned no matching trace, and the 23:15-23:35 window for checkout logs was read only as its newest lines (limit-truncated), so older in-window log lines were not examined.
next_steps: Collect the raw HTTP response body and status returned by shipping's '/get-quote' during failing requests (packet or access-log level) to confirm the 400 source and payload.
Compare shipping's request schema and validation settings with the payload checkout sends (Deployment shipping, otel-demo) and add request-validation logging for rejected quotes.
Verify the flagd flag values at 23:22 through change history or flagd audit logs, since the currently readable ConfigMap shows all fault flags off.
Review the OpenTelemetry collector and Prometheus restart at about 23:12-23:22 so that error history before the first available span-metric sample can be established.
